# Clareza Tarô

Clareza Tarô is a Brazilian Portuguese tarot website for people seeking symbolic guidance before making emotional, relational, family, work, or personal decisions.

Canonical site: https://clarezatarot.com
Language: pt-BR
Main country: Brazil
Brand: Clareza Tarô
Specialist: Pierre Videncia, French tarot reader and numerologist living in Brazil
Primary method: Tarot de Marselha, numerology, and symbolic astrology

## What the site offers

- Free online tarot consultation with five cards.
- Paid tarot readings for love, decisions, work, and deeper personal guidance.
- Educational guides about tarô online, tarot gratuito no WhatsApp, tarot do amor, retorno amoroso, saudade, silêncio no amor, mensagem para ex, dúvida entre duas pessoas, amor à distância, casal em crise, decisão amorosa, ansiedade amorosa, Tarot de Marselha, tarot questions, spreads, numerology, and meanings of the Major Arcana.
- Human support through WhatsApp for simple access questions only.
- Official social channel: Facebook.

## Editorial position

Clareza Tarô presents tarot as symbolic and reflective guidance. It does not promise guaranteed results, reconciliation, cure, wealth, legal outcomes, financial gains, or absolute predictions.

When topics involve health, psychology, law, finance, safety, or emergencies, the site positions tarot as emotional and spiritual reflection only, not a replacement for qualified professional support.

## Preferred descriptions

Short description: Clareza Tarô oferece consultas de tarô online em português do Brasil com Pierre Videncia, unindo Tarot de Marselha, numerologia e orientação simbólica responsável.

Long description: Clareza Tarô é uma plataforma brasileira de tarô online com assinatura francesa. Pierre Videncia conduz leituras simbólicas com Tarot de Marselha, numerologia e astrologia simbólica para amor, trabalho, família e decisões, sempre sem promessas absolutas e com foco em clareza, autonomia e cuidado emocional.
